```python
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
from typing import Optional, Union


class ErrorCode(Enum):
    """Enumerated rejection causes for verify_event. Satisfies AC-15."""
    UNKNOWN_KEY_ID = "unknown_key_id"
    REVOKED_KEY_ID = "revoked_key_id"
    SIGNATURE_MISMATCH = "signature_mismatch"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerificationError:
    """Structured rejection. Never carries raw signature bytes. Satisfies AC-15."""
    code: ErrorCode
    actor_id_claim: str
    key_id_claim: str
    event_id: str
    message: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerificationOk:
    """Successful verification result. `deprecated_key_warning` is True when the
    key_id used is in `deprecated` status. Satisfies AC-15."""
    actor_id: str
    key_id: str
    event_id: str
    deprecated_key_warning: bool


VerificationResult = Union[VerificationOk, VerificationError]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoredEvent:
    """Event as persisted, used for re-verification.

    `canonical_envelope` is the exact RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON bytes that
    were signed at write time; re-verification MUST use these bytes rather than
    re-serializing from jsonb. Satisfies AC-26."""
    event_id: str
    actor_id_claim: str
    key_id_claim: str
    canonical_envelope: bytes
    payload_canonical_hash: bytes
    signature: bytes


class KeyStatus(Enum):
    """Satisfies AC-15."""
    ACTIVE = "active"
    DEPRECATED = "deprecated"
    REVOKED = "revoked"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActorKey:
    """A single key entry in the per-actor key set. Satisfies AC-15."""
    actor_id: str
    key_id: str
    secret: bytes
    status: KeyStatus


class KeySet:
    """Per-actor key set with status lookups. Satisfies AC-15."""

    def lookup(self, actor_id: str, key_id: str) -> Optional[ActorKey]:
        """Return the key entry or None if no such (actor_id, key_id) pair exists."""
        ...


def verify_event(event: StoredEvent, key_set: KeySet) -> VerificationResult:
    """Satisfies AC-15, AC-26."""
    ...
```
